en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large neoclassical palace with arcades and a colonnaded wing, surrounded by gardens and an open square where two people are walking. There is cursive handwriting across the image and margins. Printed caption at the bottom reads in French "SOUVENIR DE CORFOU - Palais Royal." A small printed credit appears along the left edge, and a watermark with the URL "www.elia.org.gr" is overlaid.
